preconditions.description: n is the length of the serial number (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), and m + k is the total number of changes and checks (1 ≤ m + k ≤ 10^5).

preconditions.expression: len(serial_number) == n and all(c.isdigit() for c in serial_number)
preconditions.description: The serial number is a string of exactly n digits (0-9).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for line in changes_and_checks if line.startswith('1') and (l := int(line.split()[1])) and (r := int(line.split()[2])))
preconditions.description: For each change operation (1 l r c), the substring indices l and r are valid (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n and 1 <= d <= r - l + 1 for line in changes_and_checks if line.startswith('2') and (l := int(line.split()[1])) and (r := int(line.split()[2])) and (d := int(line.split()[3])))
preconditions.description: For each check operation (2 l r d), the substring indices l and r are valid (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n), and d is a valid period (1 ≤ d ≤ r - l + 1).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 9 for line in changes_and_checks if line.startswith('1') and (c := int(line.split()[3])))
preconditions.description: For each change operation (1 l r c), the digit c is between 0 and 9.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each check operation, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda: (s := current_serial_number), (l := int(line.split()[1])), (r := int(line.split()[2])), (d := int(line.split()[3])), (substring := s[l-1:r]), (period_valid := all(substring[i] == substring[i+d] for i in range(len(substring) - d))), (output_line == 'YES' if period_valid else 'NO'))(line) for line in changes_and_checks if line.startswith('2'))
postconditions.description: For each check operation (2 l r d), the output is 'YES' if the substring from l to r (1-based) in the current serial number has period d (i.e., substring[i] == substring[i+d] for all valid i), otherwise 'NO'.
